translation:
Treats redness, swelling, and films.

One earthworm, take a large and white one, tie its head and tail with thread, wash it clean in running water, split it open with a porcelain shard, drip out the white juice, put it into the prepared stone, and apply it to the eye; it is also effective.

One: to remove fleshy growths, take a hundred apricot kernels, pound them to extract the juice, blend with prepared Naosha and apply, or one may also use Bai Dingxiang.
translator_notes: 人龍 (renlong) is a medicinal name for the earthworm.
制石 (prepared stone) refers to the prepared stone of the preceding Wudang secret formula.
製硇砂 (prepared Naosha) means processed Naosha.
